rows.note: `require Req::Target;` — bareword module form. `use Foo::Bar` resolves; `require Foo::Bar` emits no ref at all (rule #7 gap). CST trap: `require_expression` has NO module: field, just a bareword child (require VERSION is a separate `require_version_expression` kind, so version asserts are structurally excluded). String-path `require "x.pl"` is documentLink's territory, not this row.
